events.headline: Command adds external credit-card spending analysis
events.summary: Personal customers can connect external credit cards and ask Command for spending analysis and visualizations.

events.headline: Mercury launches Agent Controls
events.summary: Customers can inspect connected AI agents, restrict their permissions, review activity, and disconnect access.

events.headline: Mercury redesigns Treasury
events.summary: Treasury adds expense-based portfolio recommendations, U.S. Treasury ladders, and portfolio rebalancing.

events.headline: Mercury launches Payroll
events.summary: Integrated payroll includes employee and contractor payments, benefits, retirement plans, and payroll compliance support.

events.headline: Mercury enables account actions through ChatGPT and Claude
events.summary: Connected assistants can prepare transfers, recipient payments, and transaction categorization, subject to customer approval.

events.headline: Mercury adds linked-account transfers and recurring external payments
events.summary: Customers can connect Mercury accounts, automate transfers between them, and schedule recurring payments to external accounts.

events.headline: Mercury API adds real-time payments
events.summary: Business and Personal accounts provided through Column can send real-time payments programmatically.

cost_basis: tokens x list price + $10 per 1K web search calls
